G2113779.description: Majuro (; Marshallese: Mājro [mʲæzʲ(e)rˠo]) is the capital and largest city of the Marshall Islands. It is also a large coral atoll of 64 islands in the Pacific Ocean.

G7304298.description: Laura (Marshallese: Ļora, [lˠɔːrˠɑ]) is an island town situated in Marshall Islands. It is located in the west of Majuro Atoll.
